messages:
reon: FYI QA found a weird spike: our Android sample app retried a bunch of SDK requests immediately after device wake and exhausted quota. Not the usual currentTimeMillis bug?
amara: Did you persist absolute retry timestamps?
reon: No — we used Handler.postDelayed from a foreground service, thought it was fine. Logs show many retries firing at same second on wake.
jake: Handler.postDelayed is susceptible to Doze/clock changes. Also Handler uses uptime vs wall clock depending on API.
sophie: If you want retries to survive process restarts and be monotonic, don't save epoch millis. Save remaining delay or a monotonic deadline: SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + backoff.
amara: Another wrinkle: we used AlarmManager.set() which is inexact and can be batched by the OS. For persisted retries prefer AlarmManager.setExactAndAllowWhileIdle with ELAPSED_REALTIME_WAKEUP or WorkManager with backoff criteria if you need persistence across reboots. But WorkManager will batch aggressively unless you add jitter.
reon: We were using AlarmManager.set with RTC_WAKEUP and storing epoch millis. Races when device time changed/NTP updated caused bunching. Switching to ELAPSED_REALTIME_WAKEUP fixed one class of cases.
jake: Jitter is critical. We saw everyone seeded Random with the same seed at cold start and jitter collapsed. Use ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextLong(0, jitterMs) or SecureRandom for per-process entropy.
sophie: Also check OkHttp dispatcher limits — if many retries enqueue simultaneously, dispatcher.maxRequestsPerHost (default 5) can cause queuing and head-of-queue starvation if hung requests block threads. Consider increasing or using async enqueue always.
amara: For sample app doc: recommend these rules — 1) schedule backoff using elapsedRealtime 2) persist remaining delay or monotonic deadline, not wall-time 3) include random jitter != deterministic seed 4) prefer WorkManager for durable jobs but still add jitter 5) avoid readTimeout=0 for streaming in samples (use call.timeout or per-chunk timeouts).
reon: Good checklist. I'll patch the sample app and add a small emulator e2e that toggles wifi and simulates sleep/wake to catch regressions.
ci-bot: ci/test run started for branch fix/monotonic-retries-229
reon: Thanks all — saving future customers from quota blasts.
